text: Managing a team is not always easy, but good leaders follow a few simple rules. First, clear communication is essential: everyone should know their tasks and deadlines. Second, delegation helps because a leader cannot do everything alone, so sharing work builds trust. Third, giving regular feedback helps team members improve and feel valued. Motivation matters too, so it is important to recognise good work and encourage people. Finally, when conflicts appear, a good manager listens to both sides calmly and finds a fair solution. By combining these skills, any team can work together more effectively and reach its goals.
